Lens / perspective: 50mm-equivalent natural perspective with balanced proportions and modest depth compression.
RIGHT HAND: her own right hand is in PROP — her near arm, on the camera side.
LEFT HAND: her own left hand is in PROP — her far arm, on the side away from the camera.
PROP: with both hands she trims the stems of a few loose flower stems on the worktable — her own right hand holds small shears, her own left hand holds the stems.
LEGS: knees together, feet slightly apart.

Leave behind everything she wears in the attached image — no crown, tiara, helmet, feathers, headpiece, hairpins from it, armour or regalia; her hair is styled for the everyday outfit, with at most one small accessory.

Her element — nickel: a warm silver-grey metal that fell from the sky — iron meteorites are iron and nickel together, and when a slice is polished and etched a criss-cross lattice of crystal bands, the Widmanstätten pattern, appears that only millions of years of slow cooling in space can grow; it rests with iron in the Earth's core; miners cursed its ore as the 'copper demon' because it looked like copper yet yielded none; it shines as the silver of coins and mirror-bright plating, it is one of the three metals a magnet holds, and its salts dissolve into clear apple green; loyal, steady and patient — may show in the outfit's details, motifs or small accessories.
